name: Crossref REST API
rate_limits: 50 req/s (public pool). Use mailto= parameter for 'polite pool' with better rate limits and priority. Revised rate limits as of Dec 2025.
notes: 170M+ metadata records. No signup or API key required. Almost no metadata is copyrighted. Polite pool (add mailto= param) gets better rate limits. Endpoints: /works, /journals, /members, /funders, /types, /prefixes. Supports content negotiation for multiple output formats. Excellent for DOI resolution and bibliographic metadata. Premium tier (Metadata Plus) available for higher limits.
